Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

NC-1601/G-1603/M-1212/M-1213-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 701 Mexico Place. Lot 3, Block 1430, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Tomaro Architecture
2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd., #100
Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Owner: Joseph & Annakutty Thomas
Recommendation: Actions: Continued the Miscellaneous Application Nos. M-1212-17 and M-1213-17 and approved the Neigborhood Compatibility and Grading applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The existing asphalt concrete curb along the frontage of 701 Mexico Place (Lot 3) and the lot the south of 701 Mexico Place (Lot 4) shall be removed and concrete curb and gutter constructed. The curb and gutter shall be extended to join existing curb and gutter at the rear property line of 1617 Via Montemar. Separate street plans, including plan and profile, shall be prepared by a registered civil engineer and submitted for review and approval by the City Engineer; 2) The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface on Lot 3. Thus, it shall comply with the City's municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; 3) Portions of the existing wall and pilasters that lie along the southerly property line of Lot 4 encroach into City Parklands shall be removed as non-standard encroachments in Parklands; 4) The existing chainlink fencing at the rear of the property behind Lots 3 and 4 within the right-of-way along Palos Verdes Drive West shall be removed; 5) A reciprocal ingress/egress easement to the public road right-of-way across Lot 4 benefitting Lot 3 shall be prepared and submitted for review and approval by the City Engineer. The final approved easement document shall be recorded at the County Recorder's Office prior to issuance of Certificate of Occupancy; 6) Should the Palos Verdes Homes Association and/or Art Jury not approve the shared driveway design, as shown on the site plan, the project shall be redesigned to have two separate driveways for Lots 3 and 4; 7) A lot line adjustment is proposed to move the property line between Lots 3 and 4. A Certificate of Compliance Lot Line Adjustment application shall be submitted to the City and processed in accordance with Chapter 16.24 of the City's Municipal Code. The final approved Certificate of Compliance Lot Line Adjustment shall be recorded at the County Recorder's Office prior to issuance of Certificate of Occupancy; 8) The plans call out a tree within the Palos Verdes Drive West right-of-way at the rear of the property to be removed. Parklands Committee or City approval shall be obtained for the removal of the tree; 9) Landscape vegetation shall be limited to the ridge height of the adjacent building; and 10) The master bedroom patio cover shall be eliminated.
c.
NC-1603-17; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions & remodeling to the single family residence located at 2825 Via Neve. Lot 16, Block 2235, Tract 7144. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

212 San Vicente #13

d.

e.
CDP-107/M-1221-17; Consideration of Coastal Development Permit & Miscellaneous Applications for a new wrought iron fence and landscaping within the setback adjacent to the street at the single family residence located at 2801 Via Segovia. Lot 1, Tract 23062. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Rainville Design Studio
1632 Aviation Blvd.
Redondo Beach, CA 90278
Owner: Jeffrey & Roberta Coppersmith
Recommendation: Actions: Denied the Miscellaneous Application and approve the Coastal Development Permit (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Any hedge adjacent to the proposed fencing shall not exceed 6.5 ft.; 2) The fence shall extend along the bluff to fully enclose the property; and 3) A 6.5 ft. high fence shall be allowed along the 20 ft. setback line along Paseo Del Mar.
f.

Lot 24, Block 1701, Tract 6882. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Ras-A, Inc.
2507 W. 190th St.
Redondo Beach, CA 90278
Owner: Stefan & Christiane Rohrberg
Recommendation: Actions: Approved the applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Valmonte PV Stone Curb (PVE Std Plan ST-19) shall be constructed along the property frontage; 2) A new driveway approach shall be constructed at the discretion of the City Engineer; and 3) The stepping stones/pavers behind the curb within the City right-of-way shall be removed.
g.
NC-1608/G-1606/M-1225-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 700 Via Zumaya. Lot 1, Block 2318, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Douglas J. Leach, Architect
119 W. Torrance Blvd. # 24
Redondo Beach, CA 90277
Owner: Jonah & Jamie Schnel
Recommendation: Actions: Approved the applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the public right-of-way and alley, which include, but are not limited to a shed, block wall, paving, and brick sidewalk; 2) New curb, curb and gutter and/or Hollywood Berm shall be constructed per City standards along the Via Zumaya and Via Pacheco frontages per the City Engineer; 3) A new driveway approach shall be constructed per City standards with removal of the existing driveway; and 4) The second story master bedroom deck shall be limited to 160 sq. ft.
h.
Proposed Ordinance Amendment banning commercial marijuana activities, regulating indoor cultivation of marijuana for personal use, and prohibiting outdoor cultivation of marijuana for personal use within the City; and amending Section 8.56.020 (smoking prohibited) to include additional locations where smoking is prohibited in light of current state laws regarding recreational marijuana use.
Recommendation: Actions: Adopted Resolution No. PCR-2017-1036 (4-1 in favor, Criley dissenting) recommending approval of the proposed ordinance to the City Council.

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing and direct staff to prepare a resolution reflecting the Councilâ€™s direction on WT-136-15; Wireless Communication Facility application for new equipment within the City right-of-way across from 1800 Via Estudillo, and to place that resolution on the City Council Agenda for final action at its next meeting.

Introduction of Ordinance 17-724; An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates Adding Chapter 15.20 to Title 15 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code to Provide an Expedited, Streamlined Permitting Process for Electric Vehicle Charging Systems
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing and introduce upon first reading Ordinance 17-724, amending Title 15 (Building and Construction) by adding Chapter 15.20 to the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code to provide an expedited, streamlined permitting process for electric vehicle charging systems.
